pricingBody: Every project is different, so we do not use fixed packages. Tell us what you need, and we give you a clear, fixed price before any work starts. No hidden costs, and no surprise invoices later.
processIntro: A clear path from your idea to a finished product. You always know what we're doing and why.

steps.title: Understand
steps.desc: We learn your business, users, and constraints before writing a line of code.

steps.title: Design
steps.desc: We turn requirements into flows, then into interfaces you can react to early.

steps.title: Build
steps.desc: We build in small pieces and show you progress regularly, so there are no surprises at the end.

steps.title: Ship
steps.desc: We deploy, measure, and hand over a product you fully own.

projectDesc: One line describing the outcome we delivered.
teamIntro: Three people. No account managers, no hand-offs, you work directly with the people building your product.
aboutBody: We are a team of engineers and designers who take on one product at a time. You work directly with the people building your product, not a manager or an account handler.
aboutExtra: Every project starts with understanding your users and your market, then moves through design and development in tight loops until we ship something you are proud of. No handoffs, no layers, just the people building your product talking directly to you.
bios: Designs the systems and APIs that keep products fast and reliable as they grow.
Turns designs into accessible, responsive interfaces that feel effortless.
Shapes how the product looks, feels, and flows, from first idea to final pixel.

faq.q: How much does a project cost?
faq.a: It depends on what you need. Tell us about your project and we give you a clear, fixed price before any work starts. No hidden costs.
A first version usually takes a few weeks. A complete product takes longer. We give you a realistic timeline before we begin, and we keep you updated as we go.

faq.q: Do I own the final product?
faq.a: Yes. The code, the design, and all the accounts belong to you. Nothing is locked to us.

faq.q: What if I don't know exactly what I want yet?
faq.a: That is normal, and it is where we start. We help you turn a rough idea into a clear plan before anything gets built.
We do not disappear. We stay available to fix issues, make improvements, and help your product grow.
